message.content:
Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates a diffuse reticular (interstitial) pattern with preserved lung volumes, which is characteristic of lymphangioleiomyomatosis (LAM), a condition strongly associated with tuberous sclerosis complex. While LAM typically presents with cysts on CT, the diffuse interstitial markings on plain film combined with the specific association in the options points to this diagnosis over IPF (which would show volume loss) or edema.
